answer: Locks are written down in spiral, expire in summit, and opal lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 188 aliases hence needs 38 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2272 identities would post 812 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
